exposure: polyhydramnios due to late-onset gestational diabetes mellitus
cohort: The study included 295 women with polyhydramnios of nonfetal-placental origin manifesting in the third trimester, who had normal 75-g oral glucose tolerance test results between 24 and 28 weeks gestation and participated in prenatal examinations at Etlik Lady Zubeyde Hospital.
finding: There were no significant differences in composite maternal and neonatal outcomes between women with isolated polyhydramnios and those with polyhydramnios due to late-onset gestational diabetes mellitus, suggesting that distinguishing between the two may not be necessary for management.
